The dominant conflicts are two_wheeler vs two_wheeler turning, with a minimum PET of 0.4 s. Video review confirms real two-wheeler turning conflicts with evasive braking.

rows.text: Every day at this junction, scooters coming from the north side nearly hit other scooters. Someone is going to get hurt.
rows.answer: The audit recorded 176 conflicts in 599.9 s. The top hotspot is rank 1 with 14 events, rate 113.8 per 1000 users, dominant pair two_wheeler–two_wheeler, dominant type turning, approaches E 4, S 5, W 1. No hotspot shows two-wheeler to two-wheeler near-misses involving an approach from the north side.

rows.text: Every day at this junction, scooters coming from the north side and turning right nearly hit cars. Someone is going to get hurt.
rows.answer: Hotspot rank 2 shows 9 turning near-misses between two_wheeler and vehicle, rate_per_1000 95.7, min PET 0.8 s, main movement right with approaches N 17. This matches scooters from the north turning right near cars.

rows.text: Tous les jours à ce carrefour, des scooters venant du côté nord en tournant à droite manquent de percuter des voitures. Quelqu'un va être blessé.
rows.answer: Your complaint is supported by the audit. Hotspot rank 2 shows 9 near-miss events with a rate of 95.7 per 1000 users (CI 43.8–181.8). The dominant conflicts are two_wheeler–vehicle turning, with main movement right and 17 events from the north approach. The worst reviewed conflict has PET 0.8 s.

rows.text: Scooters and cars keep nearly crashing into each other at this junction.
rows.answer: The audit recorded 9 near-miss events at hotspot rank 2 with a rate of 95.7 per 1000 users. The dominant conflicts are two_wheeler–vehicle turning conflicts with minimum PET 0.8 s, matching scooters and cars nearly crashing.

rows.text: Every day at this junction, scooters coming from the east side nearly hit cars. Someone is going to get hurt.
rows.answer: The audit recorded 176 conflicts over 599.9 s with 476 two_wheeler and 368 vehicle users. The ranked hotspots are 1, 2 and 3. Hotspot rank 2 has 9 events with 94 users, rate_per_1000 95.7, dominant_pair two_wheeler vehicle, dominant_type turning, min_pet_s 0.8, movements right 9, approaches N 17. No hotspot shows two_wheeler–vehicle near-misses with a scooter approach from the east side.

rows.text: Every day at this junction, cars coming from the west side and turning right nearly hit other cars. Someone is going to get hurt.
rows.answer: The audit measured 12 events in hotspot rank 3 with 163 users, rate 73.6 per 1000. Dominant conflicts are vehicle-vehicle turning with main movement right and approaches including W 2, E 1, S 2. The hotspot shows 4 dominant turning events with min PET 0.0 s.

rows.text: Todos los días en este cruce, coches que vienen del lado oeste girando a la derecha casi chocan con otros coches. Alguien va a salir herido.
rows.answer: Su medida coincide con el hotspot 3. En ese hotspot se registraron 12 eventos con 163 usuarios, tasa 73.6 por 1000, par dominante vehículo-vehículo, tipo turning, movimiento principal right y enfoques W 2, E 1, S 2. Los conflictos dominantes son entre vehículos en maniobra de giro a la derecha con participación del enfoque oeste.

rows.text: Cars and other cars keep nearly crashing into each other at this junction.
rows.answer: The audit records hotspot rank 3 with 12 events among 163 users, rate per 1000 73.6, dominant pair vehicle-vehicle, dominant type turning. The hotspot’s dominant conflicts are vehicle-vehicle turning, matching cars nearly crashing into each other.

rows.text: Every day at this junction, cars coming from the north side nearly hit other cars. Someone is going to get hurt.
rows.answer: The audit recorded 176 conflicts in 599.9 s. The only vehicle–vehicle hotspot is rank 3 with 12 events, rate 73.6 per 1000 users, CI95 [38.0, 128.6], dominant pair vehicle-vehicle, dominant type turning, approaches E 1, W 2, S 2, entry signal G 2, main movement right. The reviewed worst conflicts show PET 0.0 s with real_conflict false and no evasive action. No hotspot shows near-misses involving vehicles coming from the north side.

rows.text: Cars and people on foot keep nearly crashing into each other at this junction.

rows.text: Scooters and people on foot keep nearly crashing into each other at this junction.
rows.answer: The audit observed 176 conflicts over 599.9 s with 476 two_wheeler and 368 vehicle users. The ranked hotspots show dominant pairs of two_wheeler–two_wheeler at rank 1 with 14 events, rate_per_1000 113.8, dominant type turning; two_wheeler–vehicle at rank 2 with 9 events, rate_per_1000 95.7, dominant type turning; vehicle–vehicle at rank 3 with 12 events, rate_per_1000 73.6, dominant type turning. No hotspot has a dominant conflict involving pedestrian users, and the worst reviewed conflict at rank 1 is PET 0.4 s between two two_wheeler with real conflict true and evasive action brake. Therefore the specific near-miss between scooters and people on foot is not observed in the measured data.

rows.text: People on foot and other people on foot keep nearly crashing into each other at this junction.
rows.answer: The audit observed 599.9 s with 476 two_wheeler and 368 vehicle users and 176 total conflicts. No pedestrian users are recorded and the three ranked hotspots show dominant pairs two_wheeler–two_wheeler, two_wheeler–vehicle and vehicle–vehicle with 14, 9 and 12 events respectively. Pedestrian–pedestrian near-misses are not observed in the measured data.

rows.text: This junction is badly designed and the traffic lights take far too long.
rows.answer: Your message does not name road users and is not about measured near-misses. The audit observed 599.9 s with 176 conflicts total, 117 by PET and 59 by TTC. Hotspots were ranked with 14 events at rank 1, 9 events at rank 2, and 12 events at rank 3.

rows.text: There is too much horn noise here at night, please do something about it.

The audit observed 599.9 s with 176 conflicts in total, 117 by PET and 59 by TTC. The ranked hotspots are rank 1 with 14 events, rank 2 with 9 events, rank 3 with 12 events. I cannot link the complaint to measured near-misses from the audit alone.

rows.text: Every day at this junction, cars coming from the west side and turning left nearly hit other cars. Someone is going to get hurt.
rows.answer: The audit shows no hotspot where vehicle-vehicle turning near-misses are dominated by west-approach left-turns. Rank 2, the turning hotspot, has 13 events with 8 turning events, approaches W 4, E 1, N 3, S 2 and movements right 4, unknown 3, left 1, through 2, u_turn 2. The dominant movement is right, not left, and only one left-turn movement is recorded in its dominant conflicts.

rows.text: Todos los días en este cruce, coches que vienen del lado oeste girando a la izquierda casi chocan con otros coches. Alguien va a salir herido.
rows.answer: La auditoría registra 13 eventos en el hotspot de giro con tasa 185.7 por 1000 usuarios y 8 conflictos dominantes de giro vehículo-vehículo. Los movimientos dominantes son right con 4 eventos y las aproximaciones son W 4, E 1, N 3, S 2; el movimiento left aparece solo 1 vez y el main_movement es right. No se observa un patrón dominante de vehículos que vienen del oeste girando a la izquierda.

Dominant type is turning with main movement right, approaches W 4, E 1, N 3, S 2, and 8 events in the dominant vehicle-vehicle turning group. The worst reviewed conflict in this hotspot has PET 0.0 s.

rows.text: Every day at this junction, cars coming from the east side and going straight nearly hit other cars. Someone is going to get hurt.
rows.answer: The audit recorded 222 conflicts in 535.1 s with 303 vehicles and 321 two-wheelers. The top hotspot (rank 1) has 33 events with rate 169.2 per 1000 users, dominant pair vehicle-vehicle, dominant type crossing, main movement left, movements left 9 through 8 right 3, approaches E 11 W 12 N 1, min PET 0.3 s. The worst reviewed conflict at this hotspot is PET 0.3 s vehicle-vehicle crossing with B traveling east while A creeps south and A brakes to yield. No hotspot shows dominant vehicle-vehicle near-misses where vehicles coming from the east going straight are the dominant conflict pattern.

rows.text: Todos los días en este cruce, coches que vienen del lado este siguiendo recto casi chocan con otros coches. Alguien va a salir herido.
rows.answer: Su observación coincide con el hotspot 1. En la auditoría se registraron 33 eventos en ese punto con una tasa de 169.2 por 1000 usuarios, IC95% [116.5, 237.7]. El par dominante es vehículo-vehículo y el tipo dominante es crossing, con 20 eventos dominantes. Las aproximaciones implicadas son E 11 y W 12 y los movimientos incluyen through 8 y left 9, con movimiento principal left. El conflicto revisado más grave muestra PET 0.3 s, vehículo B circulando hacia el este mientras el vehículo A se cuela hacia el sur, frena y pasa a ~0.3 s de separación, conflicto real con acción evasiva de frenado.
